hero.title: Wanzai fireworks
hero.subtitle: A craft that has shaped Wanzai for centuries

videoHint: Video playback may use significant data — Wi-Fi recommended
paras: Wanzai’s craft of making fireworks and firecrackers was added to China’s national intangible cultural heritage list in June 2008. The local repertoire ranges from traditional firecrackers to displays that combine sound, color and patterns in the sky.

Local accounts trace Wanzai’s fireworks trade to the Tang dynasty and describe its expansion during the Song. By the Qing dynasty, makers were supplying markets beyond Jiangxi, including Guangdong and Fujian.
The county now makes thousands of varieties for domestic and overseas markets. Public shows in Wanzai bring the craft into view for visitors, especially at the old town and Longhu Park.
